case.title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH. Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels). Need: 23700 kg a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 14 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200018. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70740.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our pricing and standard terms for your requirements.

For this item, we can offer a price of €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some background on our current cost structure, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

We value our business relationship and look forward to serving you from our extensive product range.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
move.body:
Dear Franz Seidl,

thank you for your offer and for the reliable cooperation. We would like to settle this in a way that works for both sides. We can commit for the longer term, which gives you planning security: 36 months. The index AS-14404 changed -5.5 % from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09). The index PPI-C2431 changed -2.3 % from 2026-06 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-06, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08). On that basis we propose EUR 4.89 per unit, payment 90 days net, a 36-month contract, a fixed price without an index clause.

Best regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We welcome your proposal for a 36-month contract, which provides excellent planning security for both sides. 

Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. 

For a term of this length, a fixed price is not feasible, so we must include an AS-14404 index clause. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Factoring in the verified index changes, we can reduce our price to €5.50 per unit, provided we agree on a 60-day payment term. 

Our current Angebot is a price of €5.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 60 days net: a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
